subject: Medivault audit: service account ownership + SCIM/SAML evidence
messages:
From: Peter Wagner <pwagner@medivault.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Medivault Security <audit@medivault.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit request — service accounts + delegated admin evidence

Olga,

Thanks for the quick intro on Monday. As part of our SIG/SOC2 intake we need a compact evidence packet focused on service accounts and delegated/admin-scoped identities. Specifically, can you provide the following by 8/20?

- A table of active service accounts (name, principal id/email, owner name, creation date, last-used timestamp)
- For service accounts with elevated roles: a short justification and the minimal role mapping (what permissions are required)
- SCIM provisioning delta logs for the last 90 days (we'll sample if volume is large). We need a small sample (one full day) that shows provisioning, deprovisioning, and attribute updates for admin-group membership
- SAML assertion examples for our SSO flows that include role/entitlement attributes (at least 2 examples: new session + reauth)
- Any runbook or policy that documents how delegated admin privileges are granted/approved (link or PDF)

If you can, attach whatever is easiest to export and send a short note on the scope so we can mark the evidence as scoped in our tracker. We're primarily looking for proof of least privilege and owner accountability.

Happy to set up a 30-min call next week if that helps.

Thanks,
Peter
Peter Wagner
Security Manager, Medivault
audit@medivault.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Peter Wagner <pwagner@medivault.com>
Cc: Medivault Security <audit@medivault.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit request — service accounts + delegated admin evidence

Peter — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble a scoped packet and aim for 8/20 as requested. High-level plan:

1) Mina will compile the service-account inventory and owner mapping (CSV).
2) Jordan will export a 24-hour SCIM delta sample and the SAML assertion examples (sanitized).
3) I'll pull the policy/runbook PDF and add a short narrative describing approval flow and who signs off on delegated privileges.

Attachments: evidence-checklist.pdf (short mapping of your ask -> deliverable)

Couple of clarifying questions before we start:
- For "last-used" do you want API token last-used or last token refresh (we can provide both, note varies by service account type)?
- For SCIM samples, do you prefer a day with heavy provisioning (e.g., onboarding day) or a representative weekday?

We can also schedule a 30-min sync next Tue (8/11) 10:00–10:30 PT if that works for you. If not, suggest alternatives.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Lead — Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Medivault Security <audit@medivault.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 08:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit request — service accounts + delegated admin evidence

Olga/Jordan — starting the inventory now. Initial notes:

- I'll export the service-account list from the IdP dashboard and the internal inventory (our Asset DB) and reconcile by principal id. Draft CSV will include: account_name, principal_email, owner, owner_email, created_at, last_api_call, last_console_login, elevated_roles, justification_short
- For last-used we'll include both last_api_call and last_console_login columns and mark any approximations where log retention differs.
- SCIM delta: we can provide a 24-hour window from 2026-06-15 (we have a pronounced onboarding batch that day) as a sample. Jordan, can you confirm that you can pull a zip with the corresponding SCIM webhook events and the provisioning audit lines? I created svc-account-mapping-draft.csv locally and attached a first-pass.

Attachment: svc-account-mapping-draft.csv

I'll redact any internal-only IDs but keep enough detail for audit traceability.

-Mina
Mina Haddad
Identity & Access Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit request — service accounts + delegated admin evidence

Mina — confirmed. I'll pull the SCIM delta files for 2026-06-15 and a matching set of SAML assertion captures (sanitized) and put them in a shared drive folder. Plan & timeline:

- 8/11: Export SCIM webhook audit for 2026-06-15 (will include create/update/delete events).
- 8/12: Export SAML assertion examples (two captures: initial auth + reauth) and run them through our sanitizer to remove PII.
- 8/13: Consolidate into a zip scim-delta-sample-202606.zip and saml-assertion-examples.txt.
- 8/14: Upload the consolidated packet and share a Drive link (private link).

Link (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1aB2cEvidenceFolder
Task tracker: HS-2384 (collect-evidence / Medivault)

If you want me to include API token rotation logs for service accounts with elevated roles, say so — I can include a short rotation table.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Security Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Peter Wagner <pwagner@medivault.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Medivault Security <audit@medivault.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit request — service accounts + delegated admin evidence

Olga / team — appreciate the quick coordination and the concrete plan. 8/20 is fine, and the proposed artifact set looks good. A few notes:

- Please include the token rotation table for any service account with write privileges to prod systems — that'll help our control evaluation.
- For SCIM sample: the 2026-06-15 day is fine. We'll accept the sanitized SAML examples as long as the role attributes are intact.
- We'll mark the ticket HS-2384 in our tracker and expect the Drive link you referenced.

I'll take the 8/11 10:00 PT slot for a short sync — if you prefer to keep it internal until the packet is assembled, happy to do the call after 8/14.

Thanks again — we look forward to the packet.

Peter
Peter Wagner
Security Manager, Medivault
